# Oil for the Gate Lamps

*Baldwin needs more oil for the extra lamps he keeps burning near the city gate. Fetch his order from Gilbert the candlemaker, then see the lamps at the gate.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |

## Objectives

1. Talk to [Gilbert](../npcs/gilbert.md)
2. Reach [Selsior Gate](../maps/selsior_gate.md)

- 50 EXP
- 120 mesos
- [Red Potion](../items/red_potion.md) x5
